title: Lucent Desktop
description: Interactive dark-glass desktop: a configurable widget canvas (add / remove / resize / drag / reorder, persisted) across two spaces, with glass chrome. Widgets are registry-composed (one component + one registry entry + one seed row). Runs on a localStorage LayoutStore adapter, swappable for Convex. Props: initialSpace (0|1), store (LayoutStore), brand ({ name, glyph? }) — no hardcoded consumer URLs/env/roles. Storage namespace: rr:glass-desktop:v1.
